## Load data

Compare combined-effects estimates aggregated at two Bd load detection thresholds
(th1 vs th10) from `intermediates/th_sensitivity_analysis/`.

```{r}
m11b_th1 = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "th_sensitivity_analysis", "unified_03_c_combined_effects_agg_m11b_th1.csv")) %>%
  mutate(threshold = "th1",
         model = "m11b",
         mth = "m11b_th1")

m11b_th10 = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "th_sensitivity_analysis", "unified_03_c_combined_effects_agg_m11b_th10.csv")) %>%
  mutate(threshold = "th10",
         model = "m11b",
         mth = "m11b_th10")

m11d_th1 = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "th_sensitivity_analysis", "unified_03_c_combined_effects_agg_m11d_th1.csv")) %>%
  mutate(threshold = "th1",
         model = "m11d",
         mth = "m11d_th1")

m11d_th10 = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "th_sensitivity_analysis", "unified_03_c_combined_effects_agg_m11d_th10.csv")) %>%
  mutate(threshold = "th10",
         model = "m11d",
         mth = "m11d_th10")

th_combined = bind_rows(m11b_th1,
                        m11b_th10,
                        m11d_th1,
                        m11d_th10) %>%
  mutate(threshold = factor(threshold, levels = c("th1", "th10")),
         model = factor(model, levels = c("m11b", "m11d")),
         mth = factor(mth, levels = c("m11b_th1", "m11d_th1", "m11b_th10", "m11d_th10")))

```

## Reshape

Pivot each parameter's median/50%/95% interval columns into a common long format
so each can be plotted as a boxplot summary (box = 50% CI, whiskers = 95% CI,
midline = median).

```{r}
param_prefixes = c("hu", "prevalence", "sigma", "hu_contrast", "mu_contrast")

th_long = map_dfr(param_prefixes, function(p) {
  th_combined %>%
    select(taxon_capture, mth, contrast,
           lower_95 = paste0(p, "_lower_95"),
           lower_50 = paste0(p, "_lower_50"),
           median = paste0(p, "_median"),
           upper_50 = paste0(p, "_upper_50"),
           upper_95 = paste0(p, "_upper_95")) %>%
    mutate(parameter = p)
})

```

## Boxplot comparison by species

```{r}
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 10

plot_th_comparison = function(param) {
  th_long %>%
    filter(parameter == param) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mth, fill = mth)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = lower_95, lower = lower_50, middle = median,
                      upper = upper_50, ymax = upper_95),
                 stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap("taxon_capture", scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = param, y = param, x = "threshold/model") +
    theme_minimal()
}

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("hu")

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("prevalence")

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("sigma")

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("hu_contrast")

```

